acceptance: Measured over one wave with audit_fix at enforce: LLM minutes of the second audit after a passed patch, against the repair round it replaced.

If the second audit costs more than 25% of the replaced round on median, red test first: the ship gate accepts an audit FAIL report plus a passed audit-fix.json bound to the patched tree digest (fresh-seat verdict PASS, gates green), and refuses any mismatch of tree, seat or verdict.
ADR-0158 records the decision (second audit kept or ship binding to the audit_fix record), with the measured numbers.
fix: The audit_fix wiring (branch feat/wire-audit-fix) sends a passed or held patch to a second audit over a new decision-only edge audit->audit, because the ship gate (phases/ship/audit.go verifyAuditBinding) refuses a FAIL audit report and a tree that differs from the audited tree. ADR-0158 intends the fresh-seat patch review plus the gate rerun to be the second key, with the original audit verdict standing for the rest of the diff. Decide on measured cost: keep the second audit, or bind ship to the audit-fix record.
notes: Console route: ship gate (fence). Interim decision 2026-11-02 by the console: keep the second audit (integrity first).
summary: A passed audit_fix patch goes through a second full audit because the ship gate binds to the audit report; measure that cost and decide whether ship binds to the audit_fix record instead.
title: Decide on measured cost whether ship binds to a passed audit_fix record instead of a second audit
